words.enDefinition: the part of the nervous system formed by the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The diagram colors the brain and spinal cord together to show the central nervous system in the model.
examples.zh: 图中将脑和脊髓涂成相同颜色，以表示模型里的「中枢神经系统」。

examples.en: We traced sensory signals toward the central nervous system on the classroom map of nervous pathways.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂神经通路图上沿感觉信号追踪到「中枢神经系统」。

collocations: signals entering the central nervous system

words.enDefinition: the nerves, ganglia and related neural structures outside the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The branch reaching the hand belongs to the peripheral nervous system in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，伸向手部的分支属于「周围神经系统」。

examples.en: We used the model of the peripheral nervous system to trace signals between the spine and arm.
examples.zh: 我们用「周围神经系统」模型追踪脊柱与手臂之间的信号。

collocations: signals carried by the peripheral nervous system

words.enDefinition: the division that carries information from bodily senses and sends motor signals to skeletal muscles

examples.en: The somatic nervous system sends commands to skeletal muscles during a voluntary movement in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，「躯体神经系统」在随意运动时向骨骼肌发出指令。

examples.en: We mapped a skin sensory signal and an arm motor signal within the somatic nervous system.
examples.zh: 我们在「躯体神经系统」图中标出了皮肤感觉信号和手臂运动信号。

collocations: motor signals in the somatic nervous system

words.enDefinition: the system that regulates internal organs through neural control of smooth muscle, heart muscle and glands

examples.en: The model uses the autonomic nervous system to represent changes in heart activity during a posture shift.
examples.zh: 模型用「自主神经系统」表示姿势改变时心脏活动发生的变化。

examples.en: We followed a pathway from the autonomic nervous system to a gland in the lecture drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在讲义图上沿「自主神经系统」的一条通路追踪到一处腺体。

collocations: divisions of the autonomic nervous system
control by the autonomic nervous system

words.enDefinition: the autonomic division with preganglionic neurons in thoracic and upper lumbar spinal cord, involved in mobilizing resources

examples.en: The activity diagram connects the sympathetic division with increased heart rate during the modeled exercise response.
examples.zh: 活动图把模拟运动反应中的心率加快与「交感神经分部」联系起来。

examples.en: We marked the spinal origins of the sympathetic division on the lecture slide of autonomic pathways.
examples.zh: 我们在自主神经通路课件上标出「交感神经分部」在脊髓中的起始部位。

words.enDefinition: the autonomic division with pathways arising in the brainstem and sacral spinal cord, often supporting rest and digestion

examples.en: The model links the parasympathetic division to changes in digestive activity during the resting phase of the animation.
examples.zh: 动画进入休息阶段时，模型将消化活动的变化与「副交感神经分部」联系起来。

examples.en: We colored the brainstem origins of the parasympathetic division separately from its sacral pathways on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中用不同颜色区分「副交感神经分部」的脑干起源和骶部通路。

words.enDefinition: the networks of neurons in the walls of the digestive tract that regulate local function

examples.en: The enteric nervous system appears as a network between muscle layers in the enlarged intestinal wall drawing.
examples.zh: 放大的肠壁图显示，「肠神经系统」在肌层之间形成网络。

examples.en: We linked the enteric nervous system to coordinated movement of the gut in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 我们把「肠神经系统」与课堂动画中肠道协调的运动联系起来。

collocations: control by the enteric nervous system
role of the enteric nervous system

words.enDefinition: a cell specialized to receive, process or transmit information using electrical signals and often chemical signals

examples.en: The illustrated neuron receives signals on its branches and carries electrical activity along a longer process.
examples.zh: 图中的「神经元」从短分支接收信号，再沿一条较长的突起传递电活动。

examples.en: We drew a neuron at a larger scale to show the arrangement of its main processes.
examples.zh: 我们把一个「神经元」放大绘制，以显示其主要突起的排列。

words.enDefinition: the part of a neuron containing its nucleus and much of its protein-producing machinery

examples.en: The neuronal cell body is the expanded region around the nucleus in the prepared teaching image.
examples.zh: 在制好的教学图像中，「神经元胞体」是细胞核周围较宽大的区域。

examples.en: We drew the axon emerging from one side of the neuronal cell body in the sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图上画出从「神经元胞体」一侧延出的轴突。

collocations: nucleus in the neuronal cell body

words.enDefinition: a usually branched neuronal process that receives inputs and conducts local signals toward the cell body

examples.en: Each dendrite branches repeatedly in the drawing, increasing the area available for input to the modeled neuron.
examples.zh: 在图示神经元模型中，各「树突」多次分支，从而增加可接收输入的面积。

examples.en: The illustrator marked a dendrite facing a neighboring axon terminal across a small synaptic gap.
examples.zh: 插图在小小的突触间隙一侧标出一条「树突」，对面是邻近轴突的末梢。

words.enDefinition: the neuronal process specialized for conducting action potentials from their initiation region toward target cells

examples.en: The animation shows an electrical signal traveling along the axon toward its branches at the far end.
examples.zh: 动画显示，电信号沿「轴突」向远端的各个分支传播。

examples.en: We marked the axon after locating the long process leaving the cell body in the teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先找到教学图中从胞体延出的一条长突起，再将它标记为「轴突」。

words.enDefinition: the tapered part of a neuronal cell body that joins it to the start of the axon

examples.en: The axon hillock appears as a narrowing at the junction between the cell body and axon.
examples.zh: 在胞体与轴突的交界处，「轴丘」表现为逐渐变窄的一段。

examples.en: We shaded the axon hillock separately from the adjoining initial segment in the enlarged classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的课堂图中，用不同的颜色分别标出「轴丘」和邻接的轴突起始段。

words.enDefinition: the first specialized segment of an axon where action potentials typically begin

examples.en: The animated signal first became an action potential in the axon initial segment of the model neuron.
examples.zh: 在模型神经元的动画里，信号最先在「轴突起始段」变成动作电位。

examples.en: We labeled the axon initial segment just beyond the taper of the cell body on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中胞体逐渐变细的位置之后标出「轴突起始段」。

collocations: action potential initiation at the axon initial segment

words.enDefinition: the end of an axon branch that communicates with a target cell at a synapse

examples.en: The drawing places the axon terminal close to the target cell without a visible connection between their membranes.
examples.zh: 图中「轴突末梢」靠近靶细胞，两者的细胞膜之间没有画出直接连接。

examples.en: We followed the signal down the branch to the axon terminal in the classroom simulation.
examples.zh: 在课堂模拟中，我们沿分支追踪信号直到「轴突末梢」。

words.enDefinition: a multilayered covering formed by glial membranes that electrically insulates stretches of an axon

examples.en: The myelin sheath appears as several wrapped layers around part of the axon in the enlarged drawing.
examples.zh: 在放大图中，「髓鞘」是围在轴突一段外面的多层结构。

examples.en: We compared the timing of signal propagation in axons with and without a myelin sheath in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了有「髓鞘」和无髓鞘的轴突传递信号所用的时间。

collocations: axon covered by a myelin sheath

words.enDefinition: a short gap between adjacent myelin segments where the exposed axon membrane regenerates the action potential

examples.en: We marked a node of Ranvier where two segments of the insulation left a small exposed gap.
examples.zh: 我们在两段绝缘层之间露出一小段轴突的位置标出「郎飞结」。

examples.en: The classroom diagram highlights each node of Ranvier when the simulated electrical signal reaches it in sequence.
examples.zh: 模拟电信号依次抵达各「郎飞结」时，课堂示意图逐一高亮相应位置。

collocations: electrical activity at a node of Ranvier

words.enDefinition: the non-neuronal cells of nervous tissue that support, insulate and help maintain the environment of neurons

examples.en: The slide compares neurons with neuroglia that surround them and perform several different supporting functions in the model.
examples.zh: 课件对比了神经元和围绕它们、在模型中发挥多种支持作用的「神经胶质细胞」。

examples.en: We shaded the neuroglia separately from the signaling cells in the drawing of nervous tissue.
examples.zh: 我们在神经组织图上为「神经胶质细胞」和传递信号的细胞分别着色。

words.enDefinition: a central nervous system glial cell that helps maintain the environment around neurons and blood vessels

examples.en: The teaching diagram shows an astrocyte with processes reaching toward neurons and a nearby blood vessel.
examples.zh: 教学图上的「星形胶质细胞」伸出突起，接近神经元和一根邻近血管。

examples.en: We linked the astrocyte to maintenance of the extracellular environment in the classroom tissue model.
examples.zh: 我们将「星形胶质细胞」与课堂组织模型中细胞外环境的维持联系起来。

words.enDefinition: a glial cell that forms myelin around axon segments in the central nervous system

examples.en: One oligodendrocyte extends several processes to different axon segments in the diagram of central nervous tissue.
examples.zh: 在中枢神经组织图中，一个「少突胶质细胞」伸出数条突起，连至不同的轴突节段。

examples.en: We identified the oligodendrocyte in the diagram showing myelin formed on several central axon segments.
examples.zh: 我们在显示多段中枢轴突形成髓鞘的图中辨认出「少突胶质细胞」。

words.enDefinition: a peripheral glial cell that supports axons and can form one segment of a myelin sheath

examples.en: The peripheral nerve drawing places one Schwann cell around a single myelinated segment of the axon.
examples.zh: 周围神经图中，一个「施万细胞」围绕轴突的一处有髓节段。

examples.en: We labeled the Schwann cell in the peripheral nerve illustration before comparing it with central myelin.
examples.zh: 我们在周围神经图上标出「施万细胞」，再与中枢神经系统的髓鞘作对照。

collocations: Schwann cell wrapped around an axon

words.enDefinition: a glial cell lining the brain ventricles and the central canal of the spinal cord

examples.en: An ependymal cell sits along the surface bordering the ventricular space in the classroom tissue drawing.
examples.zh: 在课堂组织图中，一个「室管膜细胞」位于与脑室腔相接的表面。

examples.en: We marked the cilia on an ependymal cell in the enlarged drawing of the ventricular lining.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的脑室衬层图上，标出了一个「室管膜细胞」的纤毛。

words.enDefinition: resident immune cells of the central nervous system that monitor tissue and clear cellular debris

examples.en: The classroom image shows microglia with branching processes distributed among the neurons in a tissue section.
examples.zh: 课堂图像显示，具有分支突起的「小胶质细胞」分布在组织切片的神经元之间。

examples.en: We used the diagram to relate microglia to removal of cellular debris in central nervous tissue.
examples.zh: 我们用图示说明「小胶质细胞」参与清除中枢神经组织中的细胞残骸。

words.enDefinition: a neuron that conveys information from a sensory receptor toward the central nervous system or a local circuit

examples.en: The sensory neuron carries information from the skin toward the spinal cord in the classroom reflex model.
examples.zh: 在课堂反射模型中，「感觉神经元」将信息从皮肤传向脊髓。

examples.en: We traced the sensory neuron from a stretch receptor to a synapse in the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 我们从一个牵张感受器沿「感觉神经元」追踪到脊髓中的一个突触。

collocations: signal carried by a sensory neuron

words.enDefinition: a neuron whose activity sends commands toward a muscle, directly or through another neuron

examples.en: The labeled motor neuron in the spinal diagram sends its axon toward a skeletal muscle in the model.
examples.zh: 图中标出的脊髓「运动神经元」将轴突伸向模型的一块骨骼肌。

examples.en: We distinguished the motor neuron from the pathway bringing information from the skin in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中区分了「运动神经元」与从皮肤传入信息的通路。

words.enDefinition: a neuron that relays or processes signals between other neurons within a circuit

examples.en: The reflex model places an interneuron between the incoming sensory pathway and an outgoing motor neuron.
examples.zh: 反射模型将一个「中间神经元」放在传入感觉通路与传出运动神经元之间。

examples.en: We used an inhibitory interneuron to explain how activation of one pathway can suppress another in the example.
examples.zh: 我们在示例中用抑制性「中间神经元」解释一条通路激活后如何抑制另一条通路。

words.enDefinition: a cluster of neuronal cell bodies in the peripheral nervous system

examples.en: The ganglion appears as a swelling on one of the roots in the classroom spinal nerve model.
examples.zh: 课堂脊神经模型中，「神经节」在其中一根神经根上表现为一处膨大。

examples.en: We labeled the ganglion after locating a cluster of peripheral neuronal cell bodies in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先在图中找出一簇周围神经元胞体，再将它标作「神经节」。

words.enDefinition: nervous tissue rich in axons, many of them myelinated, along with supporting glial cells

examples.en: The white matter surrounds the central butterfly-shaped gray region in the cross section of the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 在脊髓横切图中，「白质」围绕中央呈蝶形的灰质区域。

examples.en: We traced pathways through white matter between distant regions on the simplified brain drawing used in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂使用的简化脑图上，沿「白质」追踪连接相距较远区域的通路。

words.enDefinition: nervous tissue rich in neuronal cell bodies, dendrites and synapses, with supporting cells and axons

examples.en: The section shows gray matter at the cerebral surface and also in deeper nuclei beneath the cortex.
examples.zh: 切面图显示，大脑表面及皮层下较深的神经核团内均有「灰质」。

examples.en: We shaded the central gray matter separately from the surrounding white matter in the spinal cord drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在脊髓图中，给中央的「灰质」和周围的白质分别着色。

words.enDefinition: a bundle of axons within the central nervous system that follows an identifiable pathway

examples.en: The illustrated neural tract extends through the spinal white matter between different levels of the model.
examples.zh: 图示的「中枢神经束」穿过脊髓白质，连接模型内不同高度的部位。

examples.en: We traced an ascending neural tract toward the brain on the classroom map of sensory pathways.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂感觉通路图上沿一条上行「中枢神经束」追踪至脑。

words.enDefinition: a bundle of axons and supporting tissue occurring outside the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The cross section of a peripheral nerve showed several groups of axons surrounded by connective tissue.
examples.zh: 「周围神经」横切面显示，结缔组织围绕着若干组轴突。

examples.en: We followed a peripheral nerve from the spinal region toward the hand in the labeled illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在标注图上沿一条「周围神经」从脊柱附近追踪到手部。

words.enDefinition: one of the paired nerves associated directly with the brain, many emerging from the brainstem

examples.en: The model shows a cranial nerve leaving the brainstem on either side at the marked level.
examples.zh: 模型显示，在标出的位置各有一条「脑神经」从脑干的两侧出发。

examples.en: We traced one cranial nerve toward a structure of the face on the classroom chart of pathways.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂神经通路图上，沿一条「脑神经」追踪到面部的一处结构。

words.enDefinition: a peripheral nerve formed by the union of a dorsal and a ventral root at a spinal level

examples.en: The dorsal and ventral roots unite near an intervertebral foramen to form a spinal nerve.
examples.zh: 后根与前根在椎间孔附近会合，形成一条「脊神经」。

examples.en: We identified the spinal nerve beyond the junction before following its branches on the model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先辨认会合处外侧的「脊神经」，再在模型上追踪其各条分支。

words.enDefinition: the posterior root carrying sensory fibers into the spinal cord

examples.en: The dorsal root carries sensory signals into the posterior side of the spinal cord in the schematic.
examples.zh: 示意图中，「后根」将感觉信号带到脊髓后侧。

examples.en: We found the swelling on the dorsal root before tracing its fibers into the cord in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找到「后根」上的膨大处，再沿其纤维追踪到脊髓内。

collocations: sensory signals through the dorsal root

words.enDefinition: the anterior root carrying motor fibers out of the spinal cord

examples.en: The ventral root carries motor fibers away from the spinal cord in the classroom wiring diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂神经连线图中，运动神经纤维经「前根」从脊髓传出。

examples.en: We marked the ventral root before its junction with the posterior root in the spinal nerve model.
examples.zh: 我们在脊神经模型上，于神经前后根会合之前的部位标出「前根」。

collocations: motor signals through the ventral root

words.enDefinition: a cluster of sensory neuronal cell bodies in the dorsal root of a spinal nerve

examples.en: The dorsal root ganglion is the swelling on the posterior root before the two roots join.
examples.zh: 两根神经根会合之前，后根上的膨大部是「后根神经节」。

examples.en: We traced the cell bodies in the dorsal root ganglion to their separate sensory endings in the model.
examples.zh: 我们从「后根神经节」内的胞体分别追踪到模型中对应的感觉末梢。

collocations: cells of the dorsal root ganglion

words.enDefinition: the posterior projection of spinal gray matter, where many sensory fibers enter local circuits

examples.en: The dorsal horn appears as the thin posterior projection of gray matter in the classroom spinal section.
examples.zh: 课堂脊髓切面中，「后角」是灰质较细的后部突出。

examples.en: We traced a sensory fiber into the dorsal horn on the simplified diagram of touch pathways.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的触觉通路图上，沿一条感觉纤维追踪到「后角」。

collocations: sensory input to the dorsal horn

words.enDefinition: the anterior projection of spinal gray matter containing cell bodies of many skeletal motor neurons

examples.en: The model places large motor neuron cell bodies in the ventral horn of the spinal gray matter.
examples.zh: 模型将较大的运动神经元胞体放在脊髓灰质的「前角」内。

examples.en: We shaded the ventral horn on each side of the classroom cross section of the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂脊髓横切面图上，为左右两侧的「前角」着色。

collocations: gray matter of the ventral horn

words.enDefinition: one of the two halves of the cerebrum, each containing cortex and deeper structures

examples.en: The model separates one cerebral hemisphere from the other to expose the surface along the midline.
examples.zh: 模型将一侧「大脑半球」与另一侧分开，以露出沿正中线的表面。

examples.en: We marked the major lobes of the left cerebral hemisphere on the classroom brain diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂脑部图上标出左「大脑半球」的主要脑叶。

words.enDefinition: the outer layer of gray matter covering the cerebral hemispheres

examples.en: The cerebral cortex follows the ridges and grooves along the brain surface in the sectioned model.
examples.zh: 切开的模型中，「大脑皮层」沿着脑表面的隆起和沟槽分布。

examples.en: We compared the cerebral cortex with white matter under it in the labeled classroom brain section.
examples.zh: 我们在有标注的课堂脑切面图中，对照「大脑皮层」与下方白质。

words.enDefinition: the part of a cerebral hemisphere anterior to the central sulcus, containing areas involved in movement and planning

examples.en: The frontal lobe lies ahead of the marked central groove on the side view of the brain model.
examples.zh: 在脑模型的侧视图上，「额叶」位于标出的中央沟之前。

examples.en: We located the motor area within the frontal lobe using a colored region on the teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们根据教学图上的彩色区域，在「额叶」内找到运动区。

words.enDefinition: the cerebral lobe behind the central sulcus and above much of the temporal lobe, involved in somatic sensation and spatial processing

examples.en: The parietal lobe extends behind the central sulcus across the upper side of the model hemisphere.
examples.zh: 「顶叶」从中央沟后方延伸，覆盖模型大脑半球的上侧一带。

examples.en: We identified the touch-processing region of the parietal lobe on a classroom map of cortical areas.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂皮层区域图上找到了「顶叶」内处理触觉的区域。

words.enDefinition: the cerebral lobe below the lateral sulcus, containing areas involved in hearing, language and memory

examples.en: The temporal lobe lies beneath the lateral groove in the side view of the classroom brain model.
examples.zh: 在课堂脑模型的侧视图上，「颞叶」位于外侧沟下方。

examples.en: We marked an auditory region within the temporal lobe on the map supplied by the instructor.
examples.zh: 我们在老师提供的图上标出了「颞叶」内的一个听觉区域。

words.enDefinition: the cerebral lobe at the back of the hemisphere that contains major visual processing areas

examples.en: The classroom drawing marks the occipital lobe at the posterior end of the cerebral hemisphere.
examples.zh: 课堂图在大脑半球的后端标出「枕叶」。

examples.en: We followed the modeled visual pathway toward an area of the occipital lobe in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中沿模拟的视觉通路追踪至「枕叶」内一个区域。

collocations: visual processing in the occipital lobe

words.enDefinition: a region of cerebral cortex lying deep within the lateral sulcus, covered by parts of neighboring lobes

examples.en: The insula became visible when the layers covering the lateral sulcus were moved in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，覆盖外侧沟的部分移开后，「岛叶」变得可见。

examples.en: On the cutaway, we labeled the insula deep to the exposed edges of the neighboring lobes.
examples.zh: 在剖视图中，我们在相邻脑叶暴露边缘的深处标出「岛叶」。

words.enDefinition: a groove on the cerebral surface that separates neighboring folds or regions

examples.en: The pointer lies in a cerebral sulcus between two raised folds on the classroom brain model.
examples.zh: 课堂脑模型上，指针位于两个隆起脑回之间的「大脑沟」里。

examples.en: We used the cerebral sulcus as a landmark when comparing the outlines of two cortical regions.
examples.zh: 我们用「大脑沟」作为标志，对照两个皮层区域的轮廓。

words.enDefinition: a ridge or fold of cerebral cortex bordered by grooves

examples.en: The shaded cerebral gyrus appears as a raised fold between neighboring grooves on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，着色的「大脑回」是两条相邻脑沟之间一处隆起的皮层皱褶。

examples.en: We traced a cerebral gyrus across the brain surface before comparing the adjoining cortical areas in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先沿脑表面追踪一条「大脑回」，再比较邻近的皮层区域。

words.enDefinition: the prominent cerebral groove separating the frontal and parietal lobes

examples.en: We traced the central sulcus between the two labeled lobes on the side view of the hemisphere.
examples.zh: 我们在大脑半球侧视图上，沿两个有标注的脑叶之间追踪「中央沟」。

examples.en: The model uses the central sulcus as the landmark between the primary motor and somatosensory areas.
examples.zh: 模型用「中央沟」作为初级运动区与初级躯体感觉区之间的解剖标志。

words.enDefinition: the cortical ridge immediately anterior to the central sulcus, containing the primary motor cortex

examples.en: The precentral gyrus is the raised strip just in front of the central sulcus on our model.
examples.zh: 在模型上，「中央前回」是紧靠中央沟前方的隆起条带。

examples.en: We marked the movement-related region along the precentral gyrus on the classroom chart of cortical functions.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂皮层功能图上标出「中央前回」中与运动相关的区域。

collocations: primary motor cortex in the precentral gyrus

words.enDefinition: the cortical ridge just posterior to the central sulcus, containing the primary somatosensory cortex

examples.en: The postcentral gyrus lies immediately behind the central sulcus on the side view of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型的侧视图中，「中央后回」紧接在中央沟后面。

examples.en: We marked the body sensation map along the postcentral gyrus on the large diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在放大图的「中央后回」上标出身体感觉图谱。

collocations: somatosensory cortex in the postcentral gyrus

words.enDefinition: a cortical area in the precentral gyrus that contributes to control of voluntary movement

examples.en: The map places the primary motor cortex along a narrow strip in front of the central sulcus.
examples.zh: 图中将「初级运动皮层」放在中央沟前方的一条狭长区域。

examples.en: We compared regions of the primary motor cortex associated with the hand and foot on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图上比较「初级运动皮层」中与手和足相对应的区域。

collocations: representation in the primary motor cortex

words.enDefinition: a cortical area in the postcentral gyrus that receives and processes somatic sensory input

examples.en: The chart maps touch from different body regions onto the primary somatosensory cortex behind the central sulcus.
examples.zh: 图中将身体各区域的触觉映射到中央沟后的「初级躯体感觉皮层」。

examples.en: We followed a sensory pathway to the primary somatosensory cortex on the final panel of the handout.
examples.zh: 在讲义最后一图，我们沿感觉通路追踪至「初级躯体感觉皮层」。

collocations: activation of the primary somatosensory cortex
input to the primary somatosensory cortex

words.enDefinition: the large bundle of nerve fibers connecting corresponding and other regions of the two cerebral hemispheres

examples.en: The corpus callosum appears as a curved central band in the midsagittal view of the classroom brain model.
examples.zh: 课堂脑模型的正中矢状面上，「胼胝体」表现为中央的弧形带。

examples.en: We traced fibers of the corpus callosum across the midline in the diagram of both hemispheres.
examples.zh: 在双侧大脑半球的图中，我们沿「胼胝体」纤维跨过正中线。

collocations: regions connected by the corpus callosum

words.enDefinition: groups of deep gray matter in the hemispheres that participate in circuits for movement and other functions

examples.en: The basal nuclei appear as dark gray regions beneath the cortex in the classroom brain section.
examples.zh: 课堂用的脑切面中，「基底核」是皮层下方的几处深灰色区域。

examples.en: We followed motor circuit arrows through the basal nuclei before they returned toward the cortex.
examples.zh: 我们先沿运动环路的箭头经过「基底核」，再返回皮层方向。

collocations: role of the basal nuclei in movement

words.enDefinition: a deep brain structure that processes and relays many sensory and motor signals to the cerebral cortex

examples.en: The pathway diagram shows a sensory signal relayed by the thalamus on its way toward the cortex.
examples.zh: 通路图显示，感觉信号传向皮层途中，经过「丘脑」中继。

examples.en: We labeled the thalamus beside the third ventricle in the classroom cross section of the brain.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂脑横切面图的第三脑室旁标出了「丘脑」。

words.enDefinition: a brain region below the thalamus that coordinates many autonomic, hormonal and other internal regulatory functions

examples.en: We marked the hypothalamus below the thalamus and near the pituitary stalk in the sectioned model.
examples.zh: 在剖开的模型中，我们在丘脑下方靠近垂体柄处标出了「下丘脑」。

examples.en: The worksheet links the hypothalamus to temperature regulation and other responses that maintain internal conditions.
examples.zh: 练习将「下丘脑」与体温调节及其他维持体内条件的反应联系起来。

collocations: connection between the hypothalamus and pituitary

words.enDefinition: the structure behind the brainstem that contributes to coordination, balance and motor learning

examples.en: The cerebellum is shown behind the brainstem and beneath the back of the cerebrum in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「小脑」位于脑干后方、大脑后部的下方。

examples.en: We linked the cerebellum with timing and coordination of movements on the lecture diagram of motor pathways.
examples.zh: 在讲义的运动通路图中，我们把「小脑」与运动时序和协调联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the stalk-like part of the brain containing the midbrain, pons and medulla and connecting to the spinal cord

examples.en: The brainstem joins the spinal cord at the lower end of the classroom model's central section.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中央切面的下端，「脑干」与脊髓相连。

examples.en: We bracketed three labeled regions together to identify the brainstem on the midsagittal illustration in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在正中矢状面图上用括号圈出三个有标注的区域，把它们归为「脑干」。

words.enDefinition: the uppermost region of the brainstem between the pons and the diencephalon

examples.en: We identified the midbrain above the rounded pons on the cutaway view of the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型的剖视图中，于圆隆的脑桥上方辨认出「中脑」。

examples.en: The diagram places a narrow passage for cerebrospinal fluid within the midbrain of the sectioned brain.
examples.zh: 剖开的脑图中，将一条脑脊液通过的狭长管道画在「中脑」内。

words.enDefinition: the bulging region of the brainstem between the midbrain and medulla, containing pathways and nuclei

examples.en: The rounded front surface of the pons was visible just above the medulla in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，在延髓的正上方可看到「脑桥」圆隆的前表面。

examples.en: We traced a pathway from the pons toward the cerebellum on the labeled side view in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在标注侧视图中追踪从「脑桥」通往小脑的一条通路。

words.enDefinition: the lowest part of the brainstem, continuous with the spinal cord and involved in regulating vital functions

examples.en: The model narrows from the medulla oblongata into the upper spinal cord at the base of the brain.
examples.zh: 模型从脑底的「延髓」向上部脊髓过渡时逐渐变细。

examples.en: The classroom chart links the medulla oblongata to neural regulation of breathing and circulation in the body.
examples.zh: 课堂图将「延髓」与人体呼吸及血液循环的神经调节联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the three connective tissue membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The lecturer drew three layers of meninges between the skull and the brain surface in the diagram.
examples.zh: 老师在图中颅骨与脑表面之间画出三层「脑脊膜」。

examples.en: We traced the meninges from around the brain into the canal surrounding the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 我们沿脑周围的「脑脊膜」追踪到环绕脊髓的椎管内。

words.enDefinition: the tough outermost meningeal layer surrounding the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The dura mater is the thick outer membrane labeled beneath the skull in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，标在颅骨下方的较厚外膜是「硬膜」。

examples.en: We marked the dura mater as the outer covering before identifying the two thinner layers beneath it.
examples.zh: 我们先把外侧包膜标为「硬膜」，再辨认其下面两层较薄的膜。

words.enDefinition: the middle meningeal layer lying between the dura and pia and covering the subarachnoid space

examples.en: The classroom drawing places the arachnoid mater inside the dura but above the fluid-filled space.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「蛛网膜」位于硬膜内侧、充有液体的间隙上方。

examples.en: We labeled the arachnoid mater before tracing the space beneath it around the model of the brain.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「蛛网膜」，再追踪它下方围绕脑模型的间隙。

words.enDefinition: the thin innermost meningeal layer closely following the surface of the brain and spinal cord

examples.en: The pia mater follows the small grooves on the brain surface in the enlarged classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 在放大的课堂图中，「软膜」随脑表面的小沟起伏。

examples.en: We identified the pia mater as the inner layer directly touching the surface in the spinal model.
examples.zh: 在脊髓模型中，我们把与表面直接接触的内层标为「软膜」。

collocations: pia mater on the spinal cord

words.enDefinition: the space between the arachnoid and pia that contains cerebrospinal fluid and blood vessels

examples.en: The diagram shades the subarachnoid space between two named meningeal layers around the modeled brain.
examples.zh: 图中将模型脑周围两层已标注的脑膜之间的「蛛网膜下腔」涂上阴影。

examples.en: We followed the subarachnoid space around the brain and cord on the simplified anatomy map in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在简化解剖图中沿「蛛网膜下腔」追踪到脑和脊髓周围。

words.enDefinition: the clear fluid in brain ventricles and around the brain and spinal cord that helps cushion nervous tissue

examples.en: The arrows in the classroom drawing show cerebrospinal fluid moving between connected cavities within the brain.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的箭头显示「脑脊液」在脑内彼此连通的腔室之间流动。

examples.en: We followed the cerebrospinal fluid pathway from the internal ventricles toward spaces around the model brain.
examples.zh: 我们从内部脑室沿「脑脊液」通路追踪到模型脑周围的空间。

words.enDefinition: vascular tissue and specialized epithelium within a brain ventricle that produce much of the cerebrospinal fluid

examples.en: The model shows a choroid plexus as folded tissue projecting into the fluid space of a ventricle.
examples.zh: 模型将一处「脉络丛」画成突入脑室液腔的褶皱状组织。

examples.en: We linked the choroid plexus to cerebrospinal fluid production on the summary diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂总结图上，我们将「脉络丛」与脑脊液的生成联系起来。

collocations: fluid produced by the choroid plexus

words.enDefinition: a narrow channel through the midbrain connecting the third and fourth ventricles

examples.en: The cerebral aqueduct is the thin passage between the third and fourth ventricles in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，「中脑导水管」是第三、第四脑室之间的狭长通道。

examples.en: We traced the cerebral aqueduct through the midbrain to show the direction of fluid movement on our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们沿「中脑导水管」穿过中脑，在图上显示脑脊液的流动方向。

words.enDefinition: the selective barrier at brain microvessels that regulates movement of substances from blood into nervous tissue

examples.en: The diagram shows tightly joined vessel cells contributing to the blood-brain barrier in the brain capillary model.
examples.zh: 在脑毛细血管模型中，图示紧密相接的血管细胞参与组成「血脑屏障」。

examples.en: We used the blood-brain barrier to explain why different substances cross the illustrated vessel wall at different rates.
examples.zh: 我们用「血脑屏障」解释为何不同物质穿过图示血管壁的速率不同。

words.enDefinition: the voltage inside a cell relative to outside when the cell is not actively signaling

examples.en: The baseline represents resting membrane potential before a brief input changes the voltage in the neuron model.
examples.zh: 在神经元模型中，短暂输入改变电压前的基线代表「静息膜电位」。

examples.en: We compared the resting membrane potential with the marked threshold on the synthetic recording in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将合成记录中的「静息膜电位」与标出的阈值作比较。

collocations: resting membrane potential of a neuron

words.enDefinition: a local change in membrane voltage whose size varies with input strength and declines with distance

examples.en: The model produced a larger graded potential when the simulated stimulus opened more channels at the input site.
examples.zh: 模拟刺激在输入部位打开更多通道时，模型产生了更大的「渐变电位」。

examples.en: We plotted the graded potential at two positions to show how the local voltage change weakened with distance.
examples.zh: 我们在两个位置绘出「渐变电位」，展示局部电压变化如何随距离增加而减弱。

words.enDefinition: a brief regenerative change in membrane voltage that can propagate along an excitable cell membrane

examples.en: The action potential appears as a brief spike moving from one segment of the model axon to another.
examples.zh: 「动作电位」以短暂尖峰的形式，在模型轴突中从一个节段传到另一个节段。

examples.en: We compared the action potential with the shorter-range voltage changes marked near the simulated input.
examples.zh: 我们将「动作电位」与模拟输入附近标出的传播范围更短的电压变化比较。

words.enDefinition: the membrane voltage at which enough regenerative channel activity starts to produce an action potential under stated conditions

examples.en: When the modeled membrane reached threshold potential, the gradual voltage rise was followed by a rapid spike.
examples.zh: 模型膜电位达到「阈电位」后，缓慢升高的电压紧接着出现快速尖峰。

examples.en: We marked threshold potential on the vertical axis of the classroom graph for this neuron model.
examples.zh: 我们在该神经元模型的课堂图纵轴上标出「阈电位」。

collocations: threshold potential for an action potential

words.enDefinition: a shift of neuronal membrane voltage toward a less negative or more positive value

examples.en: The upward deflection in the figure shows neuronal depolarization as the cell interior becomes less negative.
examples.zh: 图中向上的偏转表示「神经元去极化」，此时细胞内电位变得没那么负。

examples.en: We observed neuronal depolarization before the spike in the simplified model of action potential initiation.
examples.zh: 在简化的动作电位起始模型中，我们观察到尖峰之前发生「神经元去极化」。

words.enDefinition: the return of neuronal membrane voltage toward its resting level following depolarization

examples.en: The falling phase of the simulated spike shows neuronal repolarization after the voltage reaches its peak.
examples.zh: 模拟尖峰的下降阶段显示，在电压达到峰值后发生「神经元复极化」。

examples.en: We labeled neuronal repolarization where the membrane voltage moved back toward its resting value in the trace.
examples.zh: 我们在曲线上膜电位向静息值恢复的那一段标出「神经元复极化」。

words.enDefinition: the period following a spike in which the membrane voltage is more negative than its resting level

examples.en: The shallow dip after the simulated action potential represents afterhyperpolarization before the voltage returns to baseline.
examples.zh: 模拟动作电位之后的浅凹表示「后超极化」，之后电压才恢复到基线。

examples.en: We shaded afterhyperpolarization where the example trace fell below the baseline following the main spike.
examples.zh: 我们将示例曲线在主要尖峰后低于基线的一段涂色，标出「后超极化」。

words.enDefinition: the interval around an action potential during which another action potential cannot be initiated in the same membrane region

examples.en: In the model, no second spike followed a pulse given during the absolute refractory period.
examples.zh: 在模型中，在「绝对不应期」施加脉冲后没有出现第二个尖峰。

examples.en: We marked the absolute refractory period where the model could not initiate a second action potential.
examples.zh: 我们将模型无法启动第二个动作电位的时段标为「绝对不应期」。

collocations: length of the absolute refractory period

words.enDefinition: the interval after absolute refractoriness in which a stronger than usual stimulus can start another action potential

examples.en: The simulated neuron required a stronger input to spike again during the relative refractory period.
examples.zh: 模拟神经元在「相对不应期」需要较平时更强的输入才能再次产生尖峰。

examples.en: We marked the relative refractory period where a larger input produced a second spike in the worksheet trace.
examples.zh: 在练习曲线中，较大输入仍能产生第二个尖峰的所示时段被标为「相对不应期」。

collocations: stimulus threshold in the relative refractory period

words.enDefinition: a membrane protein whose likelihood of opening or closing is affected by membrane voltage

examples.en: The model shows a voltage-gated ion channel changing its state as membrane voltage rises during the animation.
examples.zh: 动画中，模型显示「电压门控离子通道」随膜电压上升改变状态。

examples.en: We linked the sensor symbol on a voltage-gated ion channel to the voltage across the membrane.
examples.zh: 我们把「电压门控离子通道」图上的感应部分符号与跨膜电压联系起来。

collocations: activation of a voltage-gated ion channel

words.enDefinition: a membrane channel whose opening or closing changes when a chemical messenger binds to it

examples.en: The ligand-gated ion channel opens after a messenger binds to its receptor site in our synapse model.
examples.zh: 在我们的突触模型中，信使与受体位点结合后，「配体门控离子通道」打开。

examples.en: We drew a chemical messenger next to the ligand-gated ion channel on the receiving membrane in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在接收信号的膜上，于「配体门控离子通道」旁画出一个化学信使。

collocations: ligand binding to a ligand-gated ion channel

words.enDefinition: propagation along a myelinated axon in which action potentials are regenerated at successive nodes

examples.en: The animation represents saltatory conduction by showing electrical spikes regenerated at gaps between the myelinated segments.
examples.zh: 动画通过显示电尖峰在有髓轴突节段之间的间隙处再生，表示「跳跃式传导」。

examples.en: We compared saltatory conduction with propagation along the entire length of an unmyelinated model axon.
examples.zh: 我们把「跳跃式传导」与模拟无髓轴突沿全长进行的传导作比较。

words.enDefinition: a junction at which a cell releases chemical signals that act on a neighboring target cell

examples.en: The chemical synapse model shows messenger molecules crossing the narrow gap toward receptors on the receiving cell.
examples.zh: 「化学突触」模型显示信使分子跨过狭窄间隙，移向接收细胞上的受体。

examples.en: We identified the chemical synapse by its labeled messenger molecules and separate cell membranes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们依据图中标注的信使分子和彼此分开的细胞膜辨认出「化学突触」。

words.enDefinition: a junction where direct ion flow through gap junctions conveys changes in voltage between cells

examples.en: The electrical synapse diagram connects the two cells directly through channels spanning their adjoining membranes in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「电突触」图用穿过两侧相邻细胞膜的通道把两个细胞直接连起来。

examples.en: We compared the timing of signals at an electrical synapse with those at a chemical junction.
examples.zh: 我们对照「电突触」与化学性连接处的信号传递时序。

collocations: gap junctions at an electrical synapse

words.enDefinition: the signal-sending part of a neuron, usually an axon ending, at a synapse

examples.en: On the chemical synapse model, the presynaptic terminal contains small vesicles close to the cell membrane.
examples.zh: 在化学突触模型中，「突触前末梢」含有靠近细胞膜的小囊泡。

examples.en: The animation shows the signal arriving at the presynaptic terminal before chemical messengers cross the gap.
examples.zh: 动画显示，信号先到达「突触前末梢」，之后化学信使才跨过间隙。

words.enDefinition: the part of a target cell membrane that receives a signal at a synapse

examples.en: The postsynaptic membrane contains the labeled receptors on the receiving side of the classroom synapse model.
examples.zh: 课堂突触模型中，接收侧标出的受体位于「突触后膜」。

examples.en: We followed the messenger arrows from the gap to the postsynaptic membrane on the diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们沿信使箭头从间隙追踪到图中的「突触后膜」。

words.enDefinition: the narrow space between the sending and receiving membranes at a chemical synapse

examples.en: The synaptic cleft is represented by the narrow strip between the two cell membranes on our sketch.
examples.zh: 在我们的示意图中，两层细胞膜之间的窄带代表「突触间隙」。

examples.en: We drew messenger molecules moving across the synaptic cleft from the sending cell to the receiving surface.
examples.zh: 我们画出信使分子跨过「突触间隙」，从发送细胞移向接收表面。

words.enDefinition: a small membrane-bound compartment that contains neurotransmitter in a presynaptic terminal

examples.en: The enlarged drawing shows several synaptic vesicles near the membrane on the sending side of the synapse.
examples.zh: 放大图显示，突触发送侧细胞膜附近有几个「突触小泡」。

examples.en: We followed one synaptic vesicle in the animation as it fused with the illustrated sending membrane.
examples.zh: 在动画中，我们观察一个「突触小泡」与图示发送侧细胞膜融合。

words.enDefinition: a substance released by a neuron to signal to a target cell by acting on its receptors

examples.en: The classroom model shows a neurotransmitter binding to receptors on the receiving side of a chemical synapse.
examples.zh: 课堂模型显示，「神经递质」与化学突触接收侧的受体结合。

examples.en: We traced the neurotransmitter from the release site to a matching receptor drawn across the gap.
examples.zh: 我们从释放部位沿「神经递质」追踪到画在间隙另一侧的对应受体。

words.enDefinition: a local postsynaptic voltage change that increases the likelihood of an action potential

examples.en: The excitatory postsynaptic potential moved the modeled membrane voltage closer to threshold in the classroom trace.
examples.zh: 课堂示例曲线上，「兴奋性突触后电位」使模型膜电位更接近阈值。

examples.en: We linked the upward voltage deflection to an excitatory postsynaptic potential in the example where spiking became likelier.
examples.zh: 在产生尖峰的可能性增加的示例中，我们把向上的电压偏转与「兴奋性突触后电位」联系起来。

words.enDefinition: a local postsynaptic voltage response that decreases the chance of an action potential in the receiving neuron

examples.en: The inhibitory postsynaptic potential made firing less likely in the model even while another input remained active.
examples.zh: 即使另一项输入仍然有效，「抑制性突触后电位」也使模型触发动作电位的可能性下降。

examples.en: The downward deflection in this particular trace was an inhibitory postsynaptic potential in the class discussion.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论的这条特定曲线中，向下的偏转是「抑制性突触后电位」。

collocations: effect of an inhibitory postsynaptic potential

words.enDefinition: the combination of postsynaptic effects from repeated inputs close together in time

examples.en: The second input arrived before the first response decayed, producing temporal summation in the simplified neuron model.
examples.zh: 在简化神经元模型中，首次响应衰减前第二次输入已到达，从而产生「时间总和作用」。

examples.en: We modeled temporal summation by showing two closely spaced pulses arriving from the same input pathway.
examples.zh: 我们用来自同一输入通路的两个时间间隔很短的脉冲来模拟「时间总和作用」。

words.enDefinition: the combination of simultaneous or overlapping postsynaptic effects from inputs arriving at different sites

examples.en: The drawing shows spatial summation when signals from two different branches combine at the model neuron.
examples.zh: 图中两条不同分支的信号在模型神经元中合并，显示了「空间总和作用」。

examples.en: We marked the two active synapses on separate branches in the worksheet illustration of spatial summation.
examples.zh: 我们在「空间总和作用」习题图的不同分支上，分别标出两个活跃的突触。

words.enDefinition: the neural pathway connecting a sensory receptor to an effector in a reflex response

examples.en: We followed the reflex arc from a sensory receptor to the spinal cord and out to a muscle.
examples.zh: 我们沿「反射弧」从感觉感受器追踪到脊髓，再从脊髓追踪到肌肉。

examples.en: The completed reflex arc diagram includes the pathway that leaves the cord as well as the incoming fibers.
examples.zh: 完整的「反射弧」图既包括传入纤维，也包括离开脊髓的通路。

words.enDefinition: a reflex contraction of a skeletal muscle in response to its own stretch

examples.en: The animation shows a stretch reflex in which lengthening of the modeled muscle is followed by contraction.
examples.zh: 动画显示一种「牵张反射」，模型肌肉被拉长后发生收缩。

examples.en: We traced the stretch reflex from the muscle length sensor to a spinal motor neuron in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中沿「牵张反射」从肌肉长度感受器追踪至一个脊髓运动神经元。

words.enDefinition: a reflex movement that draws part of the body away from a potentially harmful stimulus

examples.en: In the model animation, the withdrawal reflex moved the foot away after a sensory signal reached the cord.
examples.zh: 在模型动画中，感觉信号抵达脊髓后，「屈曲反射」使脚移开。

examples.en: We traced the withdrawal reflex through several connected neurons on the classroom illustration of spinal circuits.
examples.zh: 我们沿课堂脊髓环路图中的多个相连神经元追踪「屈曲反射」。

words.enDefinition: a specialized cell or nerve ending that detects a stimulus and starts a sensory signal

examples.en: The skin diagram shows a sensory receptor that responds when the model deforms the surrounding tissue.
examples.zh: 皮肤图显示，模型使周围组织变形时，一处「感觉感受器」发生响应。

examples.en: We identified the sensory receptor at the starting point of the pathway in the classroom schematic.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图通路的起点辨认出「感觉感受器」。

words.enDefinition: conversion of stimulus energy or a chemical stimulus into an electrical change in a sensory cell or ending

examples.en: The diagram illustrates sensory transduction by connecting a change in light with a change in receptor voltage.
examples.zh: 图中将光照变化与感受器电压变化联系起来，展示「感觉转导」。

examples.en: We used sensory transduction to explain why the simulated nerve signal begins only after the receptor responds.
examples.zh: 我们用「感觉转导」解释为什么模拟的神经信号在感受器作出反应之后才开始。

collocations: sensory transduction in a receptor cell

words.enDefinition: a graded change in the voltage of a sensory receptor produced by a stimulus

examples.en: In the class model, a dissolved substance produces a receptor potential in a taste receptor cell.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，溶解物质使味觉感受细胞产生「感受器电位」。

examples.en: We plotted the receptor potential separately from the action potentials of the associated neuron in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们分别绘制「感受器电位」和相关神经元的动作电位。

words.enDefinition: a change, typically a decrease, in the sensory response to a stimulus that remains present

examples.en: The firing rate declined during constant pressure in the model used to illustrate sensory adaptation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂用来说明「感觉适应」的模型中，即使压力保持恒定，放电频率也下降。

examples.en: We compared two receptor responses to show that sensory adaptation can occur at different rates in the model.
examples.zh: 我们比较两种感受器响应，显示模型中的「感觉适应」可有不同速率。

words.enDefinition: the area of sensory input within which a stimulus can alter the response of a particular sensory neuron

examples.en: The diagram shades the receptive field of one neuron on a map of the surface of the skin.
examples.zh: 图中在皮肤表面图上用阴影标出了一个神经元的「感受野」。

examples.en: We compared each receptive field to find where a single touch could influence both modeled neurons.
examples.zh: 我们对比两个「感受野」，找出触碰哪里能影响两个模型神经元。

words.enDefinition: a sensory receptor that provides information about body position, movement or the force generated by muscles

examples.en: The classroom animation links a proprioceptor in a muscle to information about the limb's changing position.
examples.zh: 课堂动画将肌肉中的「本体感受器」与肢体位置变化的信息联系起来。

examples.en: We drew a proprioceptor at the start of the model pathway for sensing joint position.
examples.zh: 我们在用于感知关节位置的模型通路起点画出一个「本体感受器」。

words.enDefinition: a sensory receptor that responds to physical deformation such as pressure, vibration or stretching

examples.en: The skin model shows a mechanoreceptor responding when the soft surface above it is pressed.
examples.zh: 皮肤模型显示，上方柔软表面受到按压时，「机械感受器」产生响应。

examples.en: We compared the simulated signals of a mechanoreceptor during steady pressure and during a short vibration.
examples.zh: 我们比较恒定压力下和短暂振动下「机械感受器」的模拟信号。

words.enDefinition: a sensory receptor that responds to temperature or to changes in temperature

examples.en: The model shows a thermoreceptor changing its firing rate as the illustrated skin cools in the example.
examples.zh: 示例模型显示，所绘皮肤冷却时，「温度感受器」的放电频率发生改变。

examples.en: We marked the thermoreceptor at the start of the classroom diagram for sensing mild warmth.
examples.zh: 在感知温和热刺激的课堂图上，我们在起点标出「温度感受器」。

words.enDefinition: a sensory receptor that responds to stimuli capable of damaging tissue

examples.en: The diagram distinguishes a nociceptor detecting potential tissue damage from a receptor for light touch in class.
examples.zh: 课堂图把感知潜在组织损伤的「伤害感受器」与感知轻触的感受器区分开来。

examples.en: We traced the incoming signal from a nociceptor to the spinal cord in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型上，从「伤害感受器」沿传入信号追踪到脊髓。

words.enDefinition: a sensory cell or ending that detects the concentration or presence of particular chemicals

examples.en: The worksheet models a chemoreceptor that changes its activity when the local chemical concentration changes.
examples.zh: 练习模拟了一种「化学感受器」，其活动会随局部化学物质浓度改变。

examples.en: We used a chemoreceptor in the taste diagram to illustrate the detection of dissolved substances.
examples.zh: 我们用味觉图中的「化学感受器」展示如何检测溶解物质。

words.enDefinition: a sensory cell that converts light into an electrical response, such as a rod or cone in the retina

examples.en: The enlarged retinal model shows one photoreceptor where incoming light changes the cell's electrical response.
examples.zh: 放大的视网膜模型中，入射光使所示「感光细胞」的电响应发生改变。

examples.en: We used a photoreceptor diagram to compare the two main types of light-sensitive cells in the retina.
examples.zh: 我们用「感光细胞」图比较视网膜内两种主要的光敏细胞。

words.enDefinition: the colored ring of tissue in the eye that regulates the diameter of the pupil

examples.en: The iris surrounds the central opening on the front view of the classroom eye model.
examples.zh: 在课堂眼球模型的前视图上，「虹膜」围绕中央开口。

examples.en: We used arrows on the iris diagram to show how its muscles change the opening's size.
examples.zh: 我们在「虹膜」图上用箭头展示其肌肉怎样改变开口大小。

words.enDefinition: the opening in the center of the iris through which light enters the eye

examples.en: On the model, the pupil is the dark opening in the middle of the colored ring.
examples.zh: 模型上，「瞳孔」是彩色圆环中央的深色开口。

examples.en: We compared the size of the pupil in two classroom drawings made under different light conditions.
examples.zh: 我们比较了不同照明条件下两幅课堂图中「瞳孔」的大小。

words.enDefinition: the transparent flexible structure behind the iris that changes shape to help focus light on the retina

examples.en: Light rays bend again at the ocular lens after passing through the cornea in the diagram.
examples.zh: 在图中，光线穿过角膜后，在「眼晶状体」处再次折射。

examples.en: We marked the ocular lens on the cross section before tracing the light path to the retina.
examples.zh: 我们在切面图上先标出「眼晶状体」，再追踪至视网膜的光路。

words.enDefinition: the process by which the eye changes the shape of its lens to focus at different distances

examples.en: The classroom animation shows accommodation of the eye when the model shifts focus to a nearer object.
examples.zh: 模型把焦点转向较近物体时，课堂动画显示了「眼的调节」。

examples.en: We compared the lens outlines to see how accommodation of the eye changed the ray diagram.
examples.zh: 我们对照两个晶状体轮廓，观察「眼的调节」怎样改变光路图。

collocations: role of the lens in accommodation of the eye

words.enDefinition: a retinal sensory cell that is highly sensitive to light and supports vision under dim conditions

examples.en: The rod photoreceptor responded at a lower light level than the cone in our simplified classroom model.
examples.zh: 在简化的课堂模型中，「视杆感光细胞」能在低于视锥细胞所需的光照强度下响应。

examples.en: We labeled one rod photoreceptor in the retinal drawing showing cells outside the central fovea.
examples.zh: 我们在显示中央凹外区域的视网膜图上标出一个「视杆感光细胞」。

collocations: light detected by a rod photoreceptor

words.enDefinition: a retinal sensory cell contributing to color vision and fine detail under sufficient light

examples.en: The cone photoreceptor belongs to one of three classes with different wavelength sensitivities in the human retina.
examples.zh: 人的视网膜中，「视锥感光细胞」分为三类，所示细胞属于其中一类，各类对波长的敏感性不同。

examples.en: We marked a cone photoreceptor in the tightly packed region at the center of the retinal model.
examples.zh: 我们在视网膜模型中央细胞密集的区域标出一个「视锥感光细胞」。

words.enDefinition: the small central depression in the retinal macula specialized for sharp vision

examples.en: The diagram places the fovea centralis in the center of the area used for sharp central vision.
examples.zh: 图中将「中央凹」置于提供清晰中心视觉的区域中央。

examples.en: We linked the high cone density in the fovea centralis to resolution in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中，我们将「中央凹」内较高的视锥细胞密度与视觉分辨能力联系起来。

collocations: cone density in the fovea centralis

words.enDefinition: the area of the retina where optic nerve fibers exit and photoreceptors are absent

examples.en: The model marks the optic disc where the optic nerve leaves the back of the eye.
examples.zh: 模型在视神经离开眼球后部的位置标出「视盘」。

examples.en: We used the optic disc to explain the blind spot in the classroom visual field illustration.
examples.zh: 在课堂视野图上，我们用「视盘」解释盲点。

collocations: nerve fibers at the optic disc

words.enDefinition: the region where some optic nerve fibers cross to the opposite side of the brain

examples.en: The optic chiasm was the crossing point for only some fibers in the classroom visual pathway model.
examples.zh: 在课堂视觉通路模型中，只有一部分纤维在「视交叉」处交叉。

examples.en: We traced the fibers from the nasal half of each retina through the optic chiasm in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们追踪来自每侧视网膜鼻侧半部的纤维如何经过「视交叉」。

collocations: fibers passing through the optic chiasm

words.enDefinition: the thin membrane between the outer and middle ear that vibrates in response to sound

examples.en: The animation shows the tympanic membrane vibrating when a sound wave reaches the end of the ear canal.
examples.zh: 动画显示，声波到达耳道末端时，「鼓膜」振动。

examples.en: We marked the tympanic membrane between the ear canal and the chamber holding the small bones.
examples.zh: 我们在耳道与容纳小骨的腔之间标出「鼓膜」。

words.enDefinition: the three small middle-ear bones that transmit vibration from the eardrum to the inner ear

examples.en: The classroom ear model shows three auditory ossicles forming a short chain beyond the eardrum.
examples.zh: 课堂耳部模型显示，三块「听小骨」在鼓膜之后连成短链。

examples.en: We followed the direction of vibration through the auditory ossicles before identifying the inner ear entrance.
examples.zh: 我们沿「听小骨」追踪振动传递的方向，然后辨认通向内耳的开口。

words.enDefinition: the spiral structure in the inner ear that contains the sensory organ for hearing

examples.en: The cochlea is drawn as a spiral beside the balance structures in the classroom ear model.
examples.zh: 在课堂耳部模型中，「耳蜗」被画成一个螺旋结构，位于平衡器官旁。

examples.en: We traced the modeled sound vibration into the cochlea before discussing how the sensory cells respond.
examples.zh: 我们先沿模型中的声振动追踪至「耳蜗」，再讨论感觉细胞如何响应。

words.enDefinition: the sensory structure in the cochlea that contains the hair cells involved in hearing

examples.en: The enlarged section places the organ of Corti on the basilar membrane inside the model cochlea.
examples.zh: 放大的切面图将「柯蒂器」画在模型耳蜗内的基底膜上。

examples.en: We labeled the hearing receptor cells within the organ of Corti on the classroom ear diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂耳部图的「柯蒂器」内标出听觉感受细胞。

collocations: hair cells of the organ of Corti
structure of the organ of Corti

words.enDefinition: the membrane in the cochlea that supports the organ of Corti and vibrates in a frequency-dependent pattern

examples.en: The animation shows the basilar membrane moving most strongly at different positions for two simulated tones.
examples.zh: 对两个模拟音调，动画所示「耳蜗基底膜」振动最强的位置不同。

examples.en: We traced the basilar membrane beneath the hair cell region in the enlarged cross section of the cochlea.
examples.zh: 我们在耳蜗放大横切面里，沿毛细胞区域下方追踪「耳蜗基底膜」。

collocations: frequency response of the basilar membrane

words.enDefinition: a sensory cell of the cochlea that converts movement of its hair bundle into an electrical response

examples.en: The diagram shows an auditory hair cell responding when its hair bundle bends in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型图显示，毛束弯曲时，「听觉毛细胞」发生响应。

examples.en: We marked the auditory hair cell within the receptor layer shown in the magnified section of the cochlea.
examples.zh: 我们在耳蜗放大切面所示感受器层中标出「听觉毛细胞」。

collocations: hair bundle of an auditory hair cell

words.enDefinition: the inner-ear structures that sense head movement and orientation, including the semicircular ducts, utricle and saccule

examples.en: The vestibular apparatus appears beside the cochlea in the model comparing balance and hearing structures.
examples.zh: 对比平衡和听觉结构的模型中，「前庭器官」位于耳蜗旁。

examples.en: We highlighted the vestibular apparatus on the diagram before tracing signals related to head motion.
examples.zh: 我们先在图中突出「前庭器官」，再追踪与头部运动有关的信号。

collocations: sensory signals from the vestibular apparatus

words.enDefinition: one of three curved bony channels housing the ducts whose receptors sense angular head acceleration

examples.en: The model displays each semicircular canal as a loop oriented in a different plane inside the inner ear.
examples.zh: 模型将各「半规管」画成内耳中分别处于不同平面的环。

examples.en: We traced a semicircular canal to the expanded end of the membranous duct inside it.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「半规管」追踪至其中膜性管的膨大端。

words.enDefinition: an inner-ear vestibular sac most sensitive to horizontal linear acceleration and changes in head tilt when upright

examples.en: The model draws the utricle beside the saccule within the vestibular portion of the inner ear.
examples.zh: 模型在内耳的前庭部分，将「椭圆囊」画在球囊旁。

examples.en: We linked the utricle to horizontal linear acceleration in the example with the head normally upright.
examples.zh: 在头部正常直立的示例中，我们把「椭圆囊」与水平线加速度相联系。

words.enDefinition: an inner-ear vestibular sac especially sensitive to vertical linear acceleration when the head is upright

examples.en: We labeled the saccule below the utricle on the enlarged diagram of the classroom inner ear model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂内耳模型的放大图中，在椭圆囊下方标出「球囊」。

examples.en: The model links the saccule to vertical linear acceleration with the head in an upright position.
examples.zh: 模型把「球囊」与头部直立时感知垂直线加速度联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the specialized lining high in the nasal cavity that contains sensory neurons for smell

examples.en: The olfactory epithelium is marked near the roof of the nasal cavity in the classroom head section.
examples.zh: 在课堂头部切面图上，「嗅上皮」标在鼻腔顶部附近。

examples.en: We drew axons leaving the olfactory epithelium toward the structure just above it on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图上画出从「嗅上皮」发出、通向其正上方结构的轴突。

words.enDefinition: the structure above the nasal cavity that receives signals from olfactory receptor neurons

examples.en: The diagram shows small fibers entering the olfactory bulb from the sensory lining in the upper nose.
examples.zh: 图中显示，细小纤维由鼻腔上部的感觉衬里进入「嗅球」。

examples.en: We identified the olfactory bulb before following the tract toward other brain regions on the class model.
examples.zh: 我们先辨认出「嗅球」，再沿通路追踪至课堂模型上的其他脑区。

words.enDefinition: a cluster of taste receptor cells and supporting cells involved in sensing dissolved substances

examples.en: The enlarged tongue section shows a taste bud in the epithelium near the surface in our model.
examples.zh: 模型的放大舌切面图显示，靠近表面的上皮内有一个「味蕾」。

examples.en: We marked the small opening at the top of a taste bud in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上标出一个「味蕾」顶部的小开口。

words.enDefinition: a specialized cell within a taste bud that responds to dissolved substances and signals to sensory nerves

examples.en: The model shows a gustatory receptor cell responding after a dissolved substance reaches the taste bud opening.
examples.zh: 模型显示，在溶解物质到达味蕾开口后，「味觉感受细胞」产生响应。

examples.en: We drew the gustatory receptor cell next to a sensory nerve ending in the classroom taste diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「味觉感受细胞」画在课堂味觉图的一处感觉神经末梢旁。

collocations: signals from a gustatory receptor cell

words.enDefinition: an occipital cortical region that receives major visual input from the thalamus and begins cortical visual processing

examples.en: The primary visual cortex appears in the back of the model brain where the illustrated visual pathway ends.
examples.zh: 「初级视觉皮层」出现在模型脑后部，也就是图示视觉通路到达之处。

examples.en: We compared the regions of the primary visual cortex representing two parts of the visual field in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了「初级视觉皮层」中代表视野两个部分的区域。

collocations: input to the primary visual cortex
representation in the primary visual cortex

words.enDefinition: a region of the temporal lobe receiving major auditory input from the thalamus and processing sound features

examples.en: The primary auditory cortex is marked on the upper surface of the temporal lobe in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图把「初级听觉皮层」标在颞叶的上表面。

examples.en: We followed the ascending hearing pathway toward the primary auditory cortex on the final diagram in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在最后一张图里沿听觉上行通路追踪到「初级听觉皮层」。

collocations: input to the primary auditory cortex
representation in the primary auditory cortex

words.enDefinition: one of the paired fluid-filled cavities located inside the cerebral hemispheres

examples.en: The lateral ventricle appears as a curved cavity inside one hemisphere in the classroom cutaway model.
examples.zh: 在课堂剖视模型中，「侧脑室」是一侧大脑半球内的弯曲腔隙。

examples.en: We traced the illustrated fluid path from a lateral ventricle toward the opening leading to the third ventricle.
examples.zh: 我们沿图示脑脊液路径，从「侧脑室」追踪至通向第三脑室的开口。

words.enDefinition: the narrow midline cavity in the diencephalon connecting the lateral ventricles to the cerebral aqueduct

examples.en: The diagram places the third ventricle between the paired thalamic regions in the central brain section.
examples.zh: 在脑中央的切面图中，「第三脑室」位于成对的丘脑区域之间。

examples.en: We traced fluid from the third ventricle down the narrow aqueduct in the classroom brain model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂脑模型上沿狭窄的导水管向下追踪由「第三脑室」流出的脑脊液。

words.enDefinition: the cavity between the cerebellum and the brainstem that receives cerebrospinal fluid from the cerebral aqueduct

examples.en: The fourth ventricle appears between the cerebellum and the lower brainstem on the classroom midsagittal view.
examples.zh: 在课堂正中矢状面图上，「第四脑室」位于小脑与脑干下段之间。

examples.en: We followed the aqueduct to the fourth ventricle before tracing the openings toward the surrounding fluid spaces.
examples.zh: 我们沿导水管追踪至「第四脑室」，再沿各开口追踪到周围的脑脊液间隙。
